description: iteration 14 (profiling, refuted): profiled never-tested full profile - 172s total, top-4 checks 114s decomposed via per-check timing + ps child sampling; found no it.2-class waste (appends 6.6ms, no recursive greps, waits are deliberate lock-security scenarios); remaining cost is diffuse spawn overhead inherent to bash integration tests - restructuring the safety net for ~1min CI gain = disproportionate risk; closure recommendation reaffirmed; core metric unchanged (19277, 14s, green)
